construction.implementation_origin: Original isolated implementation created for this build

formats.acord_json: content.ACORD contains policy, underwriting_submission, optional claim and optional discarded policyholder
formats.acord_xml: ACORD root with Policy attributes, Claim attributes plus Reason elements, UnderwritingSubmission attributes plus Factor elements; optional discarded Policyholder
formats.claim_form: One Label: value per line. Required: Claim ID, Policy ID, Loss Amount, Loss Date, Covered, Policy Active, Evidence Complete, Decision, Reasons. Optional discarded: Policyholder, VIN, Property Address.

shared_schema.policy: policy_id, premium, premium_period=monthly|annual, currency=EUR|USD|GBP, coverage_limit, deductible
shared_schema.claim: claim_id, policy_id, loss_amount, loss_date=YYYY-MM-DD, covered, policy_active, evidence_complete, decision=approve|deny|review, reasons
shared_schema.underwriting_submission: submission_id, policy_id, factors[{name,value,disclosed=true}]; factors limited to disclosed driving_history, property_type, occupancy, safety_features and their enumerated values
shared_schema.validation: validate_document applies the same entity, provenance, financial, disclosure and decision consistency checks at input, research handoff and completed output.

cross_stage_handoffs: Research parses local supplied sources, strips identity fields, resolves claim-policy references and creates normalized attributed facts with source IDs.
Comparison consumes only the validated research envelope, not raw input. It preserves research records and propagates citations, claim reasons and disclosed factors to side-by-side rows.

behavior.research: General-purpose deterministic lexical evidence selection over attributed facts; factual findings are rendered from citations. Unmatched questions receive all available evidence, not an invented answer.
behavior.optional_callable: run_pipeline(document, selector=callable) accepts an offline evidence-ID selector. Unknown, duplicate, empty or malformed selections are rejected; no provider calls.
behavior.comparison: Monthly premiums annualized; monetary values restricted to two decimal places; mixed currencies rejected. Budget filters precede eligible-set min-max utilities. Higher coverage and lower premium/deductible are preferred. Scores use user weights; ties use policy ID. All excluded means no recommendation.
behavior.claims: Incomplete evidence requires review; otherwise inactive policies or excluded perils produce stated denial reasons; covered active claims are approved. Illustrative payment=max(0,min(loss,limit)-deductible); comparison never changes a claim decision.
behavior.privacy: Policyholder names, VINs and property addresses are never propagated. Identifiers and necessary loss facts remain; this is minimization, not anonymization.
behavior.fixtures: Explicitly synthetic invented identities, fabricated VINs and addresses. Losses and dates generated once with random.Random(47), for A then B: randint(100000,2000000)/100 and 2025-01-01 + timedelta(days=randrange(365)); persisted for deterministic replay.
behavior.errors: CLI emits exactly one JSON object with status=error and exits 2 for file or validation failures without echoing source content; success exits 0.

included: Deterministic evidence selection and preference ranking

test_outcomes.cli_output: One JSON object with status=ok, ranking POL_B then POL_A
